base: TrafficWorldV1 shared world/clock, sea rules unchanged
module: Field required only here, omitted/rejected under older rulesets; explicit migration required

terrain.basis: synthetic public test terrain anchored at Kiyosu projected world coordinate
terrain.version_binding: full terrain kinds and speeds hashed into definition version
terrain.routing: deterministic time-cost cardinal cell centers, split at boundaries; exact within-cell endpoints

formation.targets: arbitrary line endpoints and midpoint, no target cell-center snapping
formation.commands: local self-force orders, not instantaneous remote-general orders
formation.position: authoritative millimeter paths sampled at shared world seconds, same global projection
formation.restart: midmovement retarget from actual current positions; anchor return permits national journey then reentry

video.capture: Actual Godot Movie Maker frames; scripted game actions, no native input
video.scope: Synthetic Kiyosu160m land patch, terrain speed and impassability, arbitrary formation line for own three detachments; four independent save stages

scope_limits: Prototype160m region only; no national terrain coverage
Own three detachments only, no collision footprint, inter-unit avoidance, enemy combat or continuous front occupancy
Static public terrain, no fog/scouting or terrain changes
Slope traversal cost only; no continuous elevation reconstruction
National/sea round trip regression verified in Core, not new GPU nationwide movie
Return via Kiyosu anchor, no arbitrary offroad-to-national-road connector yet
next: Path smoothing and inter-unit avoidance; then contact/combat and officer-specific delivered commands
